title: Video Friday: Watch This Running Robot Not Fall Down Stairs
summary: IEEE Spectrum’s Video Friday rounds up recent robotics demos, led by a running humanoid recovering on stairs and several other locomotion and manipulation clips from Deep Robotics, DARoS, IHMC, Boston Dynamics, and others. The interesting thread is how quickly robust physical control is moving into real-world settings: MPC-based balance recovery, IHMC’s Alex walking outdoors untethered, Generative Bionics claiming motor-control and world-action models deployed in three months, and cable-climbing robot teams coordinating inspection and maintenance on bridge stay cables.

extra.full_text: Video Friday is your weekly selection of awesome robotics videos, collected by your friends at IEEE Spectrum robotics. We also post a weekly calendar of upcoming robotics events for the next few months. Please send us your events for inclusion. RSS 2026 : 13–17 July 2026, SYDNEY Summer School on Multi-Robot Systems : 29 July–4 August 2026, PRAGUE Actuate 2026 : 18–19 August 2026, SAN FRANCISCO Enjoy today’s videos! It’s been a while since a humanoid robot video actually impressed me, but the beginning of this does. Hard to know how much of that recovery was luck, though. [ Deep Robotics ] When you’re very confident in your MPC-based balance controller... I feel you, buddy. And thanks for posting this. We’ve all been there, in one way or another. [ DARoS Lab ] GENE01 designed from scratch and sent to batch production. Two scalable lower bodies. Physical AI deployed for motor control and world-action modeling. All in three months. Generative Bionics is running. [ Generative Bionics ] Alex, the newest humanoid robot built entirely by ‪IHMCRobotics‬, takes its first steps outdoors! This was a significant milestone for our team, especially because Alex is the first humanoid robot developed entirely by IHMC Robotics to venture outside the lab. These outdoor trials were conducted in preparation for a demonstration in Maryland, where Alex later successfully walked completely untethered. [ IHMC ] Built on the Enlight platform, Flexiv Mico is a compact dual-arm system engineered for safe, seamless collaboration in any workspace. [ Flexiv Robotics ] Is it weird that I’m jealous that robots can have feet that are swappable? [ Boston Dynamics ] Midweek at ICRA 2026. Cable-climbing robots that work as a squad: CCRobot-S is a team of robots with reconfigurable cable-driven manipulation that collaboratively inspect and maintain long-span bridge stay cables. Parallel operation for speed, morphological reconfiguration for reach. [ IEEE Transactions on Robotics ] I would love to know the story behind this odd choice of hat. [ Robotis ] How did Atlas learn football—and why? Go behind the scenes of School of Football and discover a glimpse of the Next of robotics. What I really want to know is, what kinds of things is it possible to do in football ( soccer ) when your robot’s joints are not constrained by biology? [ Boston Dynamics ]

summary: KH바텍은 매출의 57%를 차지하는 폴더블 스마트폰 힌지 사업 의존도를 낮추고, 협동로봇 외장 부품과 자동차 전장 부품을 새 성장축으로 키우려 하고 있다. SK증권은 회사가 2026년 하반기부터 로봇·전장 부품사로 본격 전환할 것으로 봤고, KH바텍은 2030년 로봇 사업 매출 목표를 1400억~1500억원으로 제시했다.

title: 로보티즈, '엔비디아 아이작 심' 기반 AI 워커 VR 조작 기술 공개
summary: ROBOTIS has released open source code for directly teleoperating its AI Worker mobile manipulator in VR inside NVIDIA Isaac Sim. The setup is meant to let teams validate manipulation behavior without physical hardware and generate large-scale data for physical AI training, using a ROS 2 DDS bridge to connect the simulation and control stack.

title: “AI·드론·로봇 기술 한눈에”…‘2026 대전 첨단로봇 커넥트’ 개최
summary: Daejeon is holding the 2026 Advanced Robot Connect event at the Daejeon Convention Center from June 9 to 11, repositioning its former Robot Convergence Festival from public demos and competitions toward business collaboration, investment, and commercialization. By co-hosting it with the Korea Defense Industry Development Expo, the city is trying to link AI, drones, and advanced robotics more directly with defense-industry needs and cross-sector partnerships.

extra.full_text: 대전시는 6월 9일부터 11일까지 3일간 대전컨벤션센터(DCC)에서 ‘2026 대전 첨단로봇 커넥트’를 개최한다고 5일 밝혔다.이번 행사는 그동안 시민 체험과 경진대회 중심으로 운영되던 ‘로봇융합페스티벌’을 기업 간 협력과 투자유치, 기술 사업화 중심의 산업 연계형 행사로 확대·개편한 것이 특징이다.특히 산·학·연·관·군 협력의 대표 행사인 ‘2026 대한민국 국방산업발전대전’과 함께 개최해 첨단로봇 기술과 국방산업 간 유기적으로 결합하는 융합 생태계를 선보일 예정이다.이를 통해 인공지능(AI)과 드론, 첨단 로봇산업 분야의 최신

title: MGK로보틱스, STK 2026서 적응형 로봇 '리즌' 국내 첫 공개
summary: MGK Robotics will show Flexiv’s adaptive robot RIZON for the first time in Korea at Smart Tech Korea 2026 in Seoul. RIZON combines articulated robotics with AI, force-control-based tactile sensing, and force regulation, positioning it for more flexible and intuitive industrial automation than conventional collaborative robots.

title: 印 앤서로보틱스, 창고·공장용 AMR로 80억원 유치
summary: ANSCER Robotics, an Indian deeptech startup building autonomous mobile robots for industrial material handling, raised $5.4 million, about 8.2 billion won. The company combines AMRs with fleet-management software and next-generation industrial systems, and plans to use the funding to expand its hybrid warehouse robotics lineup globally while pushing further into the U.S. logistics market.

title: AWR standardizes CNC machine tending with OnRobot electric grippers to speed changeovers
summary: Automation Within Reach is standardizing CNC machine-tending cells around OnRobot electric grippers, replacing less adaptable pneumatic setups so shops can switch more quickly between different part sizes in high-mix, low-volume production. The move matters because electric gripping gives the automation cell more programmable control and repeatability during changeovers, reducing the friction that often keeps machine shops from using robots on short-run work.

extra.full_text: In the fast-paced world of high-mix, low-volume manufacturing, the ability to pivot between different part sizes is the difference between profitability and stagnation. For many years, machine shops have been tethered to pneumatic systems that, while functional, lacked the intelligence and adaptability required for modern automation. title: GIST, ‘물체 변화 정밀 탐지’ AI 모델 개발…”로봇의 환경 변화 파악에 기여”
summary: GIST researchers developed VSCDNet, an AI model that detects real object changes by comparing videos of the same space captured at different times and from different routes. Instead of matching single images, it analyzes whole video sequences to find corresponding scenes and highlight only physical changes such as objects appearing, disappearing, or moving, which could help robots track meaningful environmental changes more reliably.

title: KAIST 인간형 조종사 ‘파이봇’ 논문, IEEE 로보틱스 최우수논문상
summary: KAIST’s PIBOT, a humanoid pilot robot developed by Hyun Chul Shim’s team, was recognized with IEEE Robotics and Automation Magazine’s Best Paper Award among papers published in 2025. The paper presents an autonomous aircraft control framework built around a human-shaped robot pilot, making the award a strong signal that KAIST’s independently developed robotics work is being taken seriously at the top tier of the field.
